items.reason: Chose 'retire with a clear error': the headerless (Driver) path has no rule registry, so it now throws Lint.Driver.Error.resolutionFailed naming the enabled rules and the header when the consumer manifest enables any. Only the consumer's own enabled set is checked; enabled rules inherited from a parent manifest are still dropped (the consumer can't edit them).

notes: Behaviour change only: Lint.Driver.configuration(at:manifestOverride:) now throws for a consumer manifest with non-empty enabled rules (also when --linter points to a manifest). No headerless Lint.swift with enabled rules exists in the workspace. New internal Lint.Driver.check(enabled:in:) with tests in Tests/Linter Core Tests/Lint.Driver Tests.swift.
